profiles.name: Feral Gargun
speciesTraits: Medium Monstrous Humanoid with 30-ft. land speed and 60-ft. black-and-white darkvision. Full ancestry gives +4 Strength, +2 Dexterity, +4 Constitution, −2 Intelligence, and −2 Charisma.
Full ancestry gives +2 natural armor. Cold resistance 5 applies to both mundane and magical cold damage.

Two racial Hit Dice give 2d8, BAB +2, base Fortitude +0, Reflex +3, and Will +3. One racial feat and 5 × (2 + Intelligence modifier) skill points. Racial class skills are Climb, Hide, Jump, Listen, Search, Spot, and Survival.
Racial proficiency covers simple weapons. Armor and shield proficiency come from other sources, such as class.
The full ancestry has two claws dealing 1d6 piercing and slashing damage each. In a full attack with a manufactured weapon, a free claw can be used as a secondary attack.

Powerful Build counts size as one category larger when advantageous on opposed checks with size modifiers and against size-dependent special attacks. It enables weapons one size larger and preserves actual space and reach. It stacks with size changes that preserve the trait.
Mountain Movement treats standing long jumps and high jumps as running jumps. An accelerated Climb check moves half speed as a move action without the usual −5 penalty.
Acclimated removes the Dungeon Master’s Guide p. 90 altitude penalties and persists after time at lower elevations.
Goliath Blood counts the Feral Gargun as a Goliath for effects keyed to race, including race-restricted magic items.
The language entry gives Gol-Kaa. Favored class Barbarian. Level adjustment +2 gives ECL 4 with the two racial Hit Dice before adding class levels.
The optional four-level Feral Gargun monster class starts with +2 Strength, −2 Intelligence, −2 Charisma, 30-ft. speed, darkvision 60 ft., Cold resistance 5, Goliath Blood, and Mountain Movement.
Monster-class level 1 gives 1d8, BAB +1, base Fortitude +0, Reflex +2 and Will +2, one feat, and two 1d4 claws. Level 2 adds +2 Strength, +2 Constitution, +1 natural armor, and Acclimated.

Monster-class level 3 adds the second 1d8, BAB +2 total, base Fortitude +0, Reflex +3 and Will +3, Powerful Build, and 1d6 claws. Level 4 adds +2 Constitution and +2 Dexterity and brings natural armor to +2 total.

Skill points for the progression are (2 + Intelligence modifier) × 4 at 1st level and (2 + Intelligence modifier) at 3rd. The four levels incorporate level adjustment. Complete the progression before multiclassing. Table 4–4 lists CR 1, 1, 2, and 2.

npcBuilds.name: Sava of Rethma

build.title: Feral Gargun glacier wayfinder, 2 Monstrous Humanoid HD and Ranger 1
traits: Leather armor +2, natural armor +2, Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 14. BAB +3, grapple +11 with Powerful Build. Fortitude +6, Reflex +7, Will +4.
Space and natural reach 5 ft. Powerful Build allows the use of a Large battleaxe in one hand.
Cold resistance 5. Alertness, Weapon Focus (claw), and class bonus Track. Wild Empathy −1.
Favored enemy Giant grants +2 weapon damage and +2 to Bluff, Listen, Sense Motive, Spot and Survival against giants.
Mountain Movement treats standing long jumps and high jumps as running jumps. An accelerated Climb check moves half speed as a move action without the usual −5 penalty.
Acclimated removes the Dungeon Master’s Guide p. 90 altitude penalties and persists after time at lower elevations.
Goliath Blood counts the Feral Gargun as a Goliath for effects keyed to race, including race-restricted magic items.
actions: Large battleaxe +7 melee, 2d6+4 slashing, critical ×3, 5-ft. reach.
Primary claws +8 melee, 1d6+4 piercing and slashing each, 5-ft. reach. Use both claws on a full attack when fighting with claws alone.
With a full attack using the battleaxe in one hand, add the free claw at +3 melee, 1d6+2 piercing and slashing.
build.tactics: Sava wants the party to help move the waymarks above the crumbling ice. She shows them where a new path crosses the ridge, then checks for giant tracks before leading anyone across.

npcBuilds.motive: Shift the route away from an ice shelf that has started to break.
npcBuilds.hook: Sava knows where the ridge takes a safe turn. She needs the party’s help moving the old waymarks before travelers follow them onto the shelf.

npcBuilds.name: Gorren of Vekra

build.title: Feral Gargun river salvage guide, Feral Gargun monster class 2
traits: Unarmored. Natural armor +1, Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 11. BAB +1, grapple +4. Fortitude +3, Reflex +3, Will +2.
Space and natural reach 5 ft. Toughness adds 3 hp. Four ranks each in Climb and Survival. Jump is untrained.
Monster-class level 2 has one Hit Die, 1d4 claws and cold resistance 5. Powerful Build and 1d6 claws arrive at level 3.
Mountain Movement treats standing long jumps and high jumps as running jumps. An accelerated Climb check moves half speed as a move action without the usual −5 penalty.
Acclimated removes the Dungeon Master’s Guide p. 90 altitude penalties and persists after time at lower elevations.
Goliath Blood counts the Feral Gargun as a Goliath for effects keyed to race, including race-restricted magic items.
actions: Shortspear +4 melee, 1d6+3 piercing, critical ×2, 5-ft. reach. Thrown +2 ranged, 20-ft. increment and the same damage.
Primary claws +4 melee, 1d4+3 piercing and slashing each, 5-ft. reach. Use both claws on a full attack when fighting with claws alone.
With a full attack using the shortspear in one hand, add the free claw at −1 melee, 1d4+1 piercing and slashing.
build.tactics: Gorren points out the ledge where a toll chest dropped during the ferry crossing. He offers to climb down on the river side if the party holds the raft against the pier.

npcBuilds.role: River salvage guide and Feral Gargun monster class 2.
npcBuilds.motive: Retrieve a missing toll chest before the river rises over the ledge.
npcBuilds.hook: Gorren can climb down to the chest while the party holds the raft at the pier.
